mentions.name: Breadboards
mentions.description: This app builder combines a Figma-like canvas for visual design with Apple Shortcuts-style logic for functionality. Instead of writing code or connecting node graphs, behavior is defined by stacking instructions using a syntax based on Hyperscript, and apps can be exported from the editor.
mentions.problem: Building app functionality normally requires writing code or connecting node graphs.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m working on an app builder that combines a Figma-like canvas for design with Apple Shortcuts-style logic for functionality.
Instead of writing code or connecting node graphs, you define behavior by stacking instructions using a syntax based on Hyperscript.
